pkgmetadata.longdescription: DMD is the reference compiler for the D programming language. This package follows Arch Linux extra/dmd: the compiler is built from the dlang/dmd tag, and the Phobos standard library plus Druntime live in dev-libs/libphobos. A first build uses dev-lang/dmd-bootstrap; the ebuild then rebuilds dmd with that stage1 compiler. Rebuilds use the installed dmd.
